value: **Computational & Agent-Based Modeling**: Engages students in constructing, programming, or debugging computational and agent-based simulation models to explore dynamic scientific or social phenomena. Evidence: "Computational models (CMs) offer pre-college students opportunities to integrate STEM disciplines with computational thinking in ways that reflect authentic STEM practice."
